description: The map (n,i)↦2n+i bijects lexicographically ordered natural-number-indexed two-point blocks with the usual natural-number order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrdinalArithmetic.twoPointBlocks_order_iso :
  Function.Bijective Lemmatheca.Entry.OrdinalArithmetic.twoPointBlocks ∧
    ∀ (x y : ℕ × Fin 2),
      Prod.Lex (fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) (fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) x y ↔
        Lemmatheca.Entry.OrdinalArithmetic.twoPointBlocks x < Lemmatheca.Entry.OrdinalArithmetic.twoPointBlocks y
